programme.desc: Banane, patate, cacahuète, cannelle, safran... Tout le monde connaît et en a sans doute déjà mangé. Mais savez-vous comment ça pousse ?

programme.title: Comment ça pousse ?
programme.desc: Banane, patate, cacahuète, cannelle, safran... Tout le monde connaît et en a sans doute déjà mangé. Mais savez-vous comment ça pousse ?

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.

programme.title: Amuse-gueule
programme.desc: Au menu : la recette de la cheffe Marie Robert, rencontre avec un chocolatier fan de musique metal, dégustation d'un petit-déjeuner typiquement parisien, le dessert de Christophe Loeffel.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Casoncellis, 100% pork ravioli.Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers a recipe for casoncellis, original crescent-shaped ravioli. Discovery of the day: the torrée, a Neuchâtel tradition.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programme.title: Comment ça pousse ?
programme.desc: Banane, patate, cacahuète, cannelle, safran... Tout le monde connaît et en a sans doute déjà mangé. Mais savez-vous comment ça pousse ?

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: A Michelin-starred chef at the Rouge restaurant in Nîmes, Georgiana Viou returns to Marseille, where it all began for the chef. The opportunity for a culinary journey blending Mediterranean traditions and Beninese influences. Between innovation and transmission, the chef proposes a walk between Maddie Les Galinettes, La Friche and La Boîte à Sardines.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: You have accidently drowned your noodles in soya sauce? Luckily, the three presenters are there to transform this mistake into an excellent accompaniment.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)
programme.desc: How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

Mills convinces Smith that they must find the evidence that connects Alex Johnstone to the missing woman before he tracks them down.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Step into the electric Jio World Garden in Mumbai for a high-stakes showdown where the road to the playoffs is on the line. Delhi Dilwale enter this tie in second place, looking to solidify their dominance and secure a "Q" next to their name for a guaranteed spot in the semifinals. On the other side, Pune United are fighting for survival, desperately needing a win after finally breaking their season-long drought earlier in the day. Witness intense matchups as tactical veterans like Trang Huynh and Max Mansoor face off against Pune's resilient stars, including the grit of Katie Morris and the power of William Sobeck. In a league where every rally counts toward the "Band of Honor," these athletes must battle both their opponents and the relentless 15-minute clock in a masterclass of professional pickleball.

Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: As she crafts a cuff bracelet from metal, author and instructor Lisa Niven Kelly shows how to size, stamp and shape a bracelet for fit and fashion. Inspired by the Spirograph(tm) and string art popular in days-gone-by, she creates a beautiful wire-wrapped pendant. In Katie's Beading Lesson, learn to make a leather wrap bracelet.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Artists see things differently. Our first featured bead type is pierced metal. Then artist Kate Richbourg creates Frida Kahlo inspired ear wires that feature the motifs in her paintings. Next artist Brenda Schweder encases found objects in a Joseph Cornell inspired piece that shows off his iconic style. Tammy Honaman ends the episode with the first of a series of projects highlighting artists' favorite materials. She begins with the art of the chenille stitch and how changing the color and finish changes the design.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: If one page is good, a whole bunch is better. This show focuses on books. First, host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer uses colorful paint pens to create an art journal page of doodled leaves. Next, Joe Rotella shares secrets of book binding demonstrating a piano hinge style binding. Then, Stacy Julian makes a treasures theme album with gold glittery elements. Last, Julie uses an electronic cutter to make numerous triangle shapes to embellish a cover for an album.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: This practical and cute quilted zipper pouch is one of Angela's favorite projects yet, because it skips the piecing and gets straight to the quilting! In this episode, she shares three quilting designs every quilter should know: ribbon candy, serpentine lines and the paisley feather, while making a small, easy quilting project for beginners that only requires two fat quarters to make!

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Are you an organized quilter or a bit on the messier side like Angela? Watch as she uses solid colors to make a tried-and-true rainbow quilt by Monique Jacobs, sharing her best organizing tips along the way.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: It was only a matter of time before the Midnight Quilt Show tackled Janice Ryan's Wallflower Quilt! You bring the wine, Angela's got the Flying Geese covered.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Believe it or not, this quilt is only made of straight seams! Watch it "unfold" as Angela conquers the Strip City pattern with Boundless blues.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Welcome to the second episode of the Holiday Gift-Along! Your hostess with the mostest (thread), Angela Walters, is back with another gift-worthy project idea: a basic quilted zipper bag with boxed corners. Don't worry, making zippers isn't as scary as you think!

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela shares her favorite way to make a quilt sandwich.

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: Let's Get Started: Sewing
programme.desc: Learn to sew, step-by-step with National Sewing Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: We were headed to the moon! Back on earth, the hippie movement took hold with loose-fitting, fluid fashions, bell bottoms, sandals, t-shirts and headbands. Dressing up included a ruffled shirt, striped hip-hugger pants and zippered boots. Londa Rohlfing shares her sewing expertise to add ruffles to any garment and Coleen Swettman sews a hippie-inspired poncho that goes everywhere today.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: This season we promised detailed step by steps for a new topic: quilting. Most of this episode is devoted to quilt techniques – at home in a quilt but also used in many sewing projects. First, it’s time for our Sew Along with Angela Wolf - adding the hem to your top. Then Joanne Banko has a patchwork coaster – 2 ways - it's jam packed with techniques for a quick gift. Last Ebony Love has her version of the flying geese block featuring chevrons and she has project ideas using the block and poly beads.

programme.title: Creative Crochet Corner presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Creative Crochet Corner is an online video streaming service all about learning how to crochet! Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being asked to go to the Marsh to bring back the rare Foxfire is a great honor for a Smurf. But Scaredy Smurf is reluctant to confront the Marsh Monster so he sends the Smurf who cannot say no.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Determined to fly over Smurf village to catch a Smurf to take to the Wizard's Convention, Gargamel invokes his Book of Spells to help him. A series of funny flying machine mishaps occur and Gargamel is once more the laughing stock of the Wizard's Convention.

programme.title: The First Telesmurf
programme.desc: Papa Smurf pours a magic potion over the new Smurf-melon patch, which instantly grows and grows all over the village and forest. The Smurfs use the blossoms as a telephone, but before Gargamel can trace their voices, the flowers turn into melons and telesmurf is no more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for something new, Vanity dons a Gargamel-made magic hat that transforms his face into a mess. Through trickery, Papa Smurf gets the antidote from the wicked wizard and once more, Vanity is beautiful.

programme.title: No Time For Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy, Brainy, Clumsy, and Smurfette discover the hourglass of time in a cave and due to their bungling, time spins erratically out of control for all of the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Due to a wild experiment Clumsy is able to store endless knowledge into his memory. Gargamel captures him, trying to unlock Papa Smurf's invisibility formula, but at the last minute, Clumsy tricks him with the wrong ingredients.

programme.title: Good Neighbour Smurf
programme.desc: When Brainy's house burns down, he moves in with his fellow Smurfs; and one by one they kick him out because of his meddling.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Harmony Steals The Show
programme.desc: Harmony unwittingly signs a contract with Ghost Writer for a symphony that imprisons him in a ghostly nightclub for life! Papa Smurf demands a jury trial with ghostly jurors and a judge that finds Harmony innocent and Ghost Writer guilty of plagiarism.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha the witch promises Gargamel a magical whistle if he will introduce her to the warlock of her dreams. But they are both deceived by each other's trickery: Gargamel dresses up as the warlock, and Hogatha's magical whistle is only a birdcall.

programme.title: A Bell For Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel puts a spell on a bell attached to Azrael's tail that will lead the cat to the Smurfs. Papa Smurf outwits him with a counter-spell that leads the wizard to Big Mouth instead of the tasty Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty dresses like Smurfette to lure an enamored gnome, Piltkin, away from the Smurf Village. They burrow underground and meet a female gnome who falls in love with Piltkin who then casts Smurfette aside for his new heartthrob.

programme.title: The Magic Earrings
programme.desc: Hogatha manages to obtain the magic golden earrings of Sonoria that will enable her to hear Smurfy voices from afar. Following Lazy's snores, she almost reaches the Smurf Village until Harmony's horn-blasts blow in her earrings and she flies home in a rage.

programme.title: Gargamel's Last Will
programme.desc: Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel, is not above playing a trick or two on his master. When he learns that Puppy, the dog that belongs to the Smurfs, bit Gargamel, Scruple tells the wizard that by midnight, he'll have changed into a dog....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When his bear runs away from his fairground show, the gruff, uncouth Malakoff thinks he's out of business. But he's able to catch a much better show: the Smurflings. Can Brainy and Wild Smurf find a way to bring back the runaway bear?

programme.title: Smurfing The Unicorns
programme.desc: When Puppy, the Smurfs' well-loved dog, drinks tainted water and becomes very sick, Papa Smurf says there is only one chance to save him – but what is needed is the touch of a unicorn's horn. Can the Smurfs find it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Nobody Smurf is the Smurf that everybody always forgets. He'd like to develop a personality, get some sort of recognition from his peers, but he fails miserably. Must he remain forever the one that is overlooked? Or will he find his true personality?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Growing, harvesting and preparing food takes up much of the Smurfs' time. Handy invents a machine that farms and processes food. But this wonderful invention has its drawbacks...

programme.title: S-Shivering S-Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter has come all of a sudden. The Smurfs are almost all victims of smurfmonia. Can Tracker Smurf find the healing smurfroot without falling into the evil Gargamel's traps?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is the dramatic, moving story of the friendship between Smurfette and her pet mouse. A sad event reduces Smurfette to tears... Can the Smurfs comfort the despairing Smurfette?

programme.title: It Came From Outer Smurf
programme.desc: Dreamy wants to encounter beings from outer space so much that no one believes him when he talks of having met one. Yet the arrival of this extraterrestrial is going to wreak havoc in the Smurf Village...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: Revenge Of The Smurfs
programme.desc: A war is raging in the Middle Ages. Knights in armor in hot pursuit inadvertently destroy the Smurfs Village so a small band of Smurfs decide to avenge this wrongdoing. Won't Papa Smurf think this is too human-like a reaction?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has found a new diabolical scheme to get rid of the Smurfs: a glittering powder that is going to reduce them to helpless laughter...

programme.title: The A-Maze-Ing Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf is dying to meet Melchior the Magnificent, creator of the famous Vanishing Box trick. Can Gargamel catch the Smurfs in Melchior's Amazing Maze?

programme.title: Smurf Van Winkle
programme.desc: Lazy Smurf is getting too lazy. The other Smurfs decide to play a trick on him: when he wakes up, he is surrounded by wrinkled, elderly Smurfs who tell him he has been sleeping for several centuries...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Scaredy Smurf runs into the Village screaming about the sky being about to smurf down. And just at the same moment, Papa Smurf is beset by uncontrollable fits of sneezing...

programme.title: Turncoat Smurf
programme.desc: Would you believe Brainy Smurf is the one who led the evil Gargamel to the Village of the Smurf? Of course he did not. But the others suspect him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What a strange stone Clumsy has unearthed! In it, he can see events that are going to happen... Yet knowing part of the future sometimes brings bad luck!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf has decided to dedicate himself to the wellbeing of his fellow Smurfs. He is going to cure them of all ills… With a little help from the evil Gargamel!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs love truffles but truffles belong to the Trolls and the Trolls live under Truffle Troll Mountain, where in the shadows of the lake lurks the Thing with No Name...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the flower fairy Nymph arrives at the Smurf Village, all the Smurfs fall for her charm and wit. And soon they learn that she is to be some sort of Mama Smurf to them...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel's theft of the Fairies' gold almost brings a state of war between the Fairies and the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' theatrical production of 'Robin Smurf' comes to life as the legendary hero is portrayed by a really good actor...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A beautiful princess is turned into a hag and needs the whiskers of a cat and the tear of a Smurf for her magic potion. Azrael, Grouchy and Jokey unwittingly cooperate and as the magical transformation takes place, the princess frees them and they happily hurry home.

programme.title: How To Smurf A Rainbow
programme.desc: Mother Nature is too busy to conjure a rainbow for the Smurfs' festival, so Papa Smurf borrows her cookbook and mixes up the recipe himself. As there is no yellow available, they use the leprechaun's gold to produce a beautiful rainbow before Gargamel can steal it.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: Lumbering Smurfs
programme.desc: Greedy tree cutters plan to chop down King Gerard's forest while he is away on vacation. Papa Smurf disguises the Smurfs as ghosts to scare the lumberjacks who willingly surrender to the returning King and his array.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for a grander hovel, Gargamel looks in the Great Book of Spells to conjure up a new home. But all of his spells backfire and that convinces him that there's no place like home!

programme.title: Speak For Yourself, Farmer Smurf
programme.desc: Farmer hides his love for Smurfette by assuming a disguise and sending her poems. When they finally meet, they are captured by Bigmouth and in their struggle to get free, they discover their mutual friendship.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: To Smurf A Thief
programme.desc: The Smurfs and Homnibus befriend an unfortunate boy who is forced to steal for his master. Soon, the evil thief is turned over to the magistrate and the boy is happy to live with Homnibus.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Little Sickly turns into a hero when he forgets his ailments and saves the rest of the Smurfs from the deadly forget-me flowers.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are so busy testing their individual willpower that they fail to notice Gargamel has captured Harmony. Only when Papa Smurf offers Gargamel a trick box to test his willpower does Harmony escape.

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: Vanity's Closest Friend
programme.desc: To Vanity Smurf there is no spectacle more enlightening, no pursuit more rewarding than looking at himself. When he meets an admiring imp, he's sure he's found his best friend ever. But things are not always that simple, and friends can make trouble.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everyday the same routine, the same chores, the same life. Smurfette is bored with it all. Wouldn't a long sailing trip on the high seas be a lot more fun? It just so happens that Dreamy Smurf is planning a cruise. Won't that be paradise?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork becomes too hot handle when he's hit by lightning. Papa has to hurry to cool him off before he burns himself out. But Clockwork nearly uses his last volt of power saving the Smurfs from Gargamel.

programme.title: Smoogle Sings The Blues
programme.desc: Chlorhydris plots to change spring into the unhappiest time of year. She goes after the Bluebird of Happiness, and transforms him into a cawing raven. Whoever hears the Song of the Raven of Unhappiness will be unhappy. It's up to Grouchy to save spring.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil Maestro's magical paints have the power to transport his models onto canvas – forever! Papa Smurf directs Painter to switch his paints and before long, Maestro is enshrined in a picture next to his dream girl, Smurfette.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. Vanity convinces her to try his recipe and before long, the wicked sorceress is covered with mud and sent careening over the hills into Gargamel's house.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn that the mind is more powerful than matter when they are fooled by a quack's outrageously expensive miracle tonic. But Papa Smurf cures the Smurfs of their temporary naiveté and the charlatan of his villainy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. Papa and the Smurfs help Lazy escape while Mother Nature has Father Time help turn Lazy's red into blue just in time for the Halloween party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: Smurfing In Sign Language

programme.desc: Handy's latest invention, the Smurfomatic Picture Maker, looks like just the thing to replace Painter's snail's-pace art. But Handy's aerial snaps of Smurf Village fall into Gargamel's hands. The Smurfs' only hope is to lead him astray.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Kenny sets his sights on a big Ohio whitetail that's been eluding him for several seasons. Using trail cam intel and patience, he puts together the perfect strategy. Then we shift gears to West Virginia where young hunters get their chance to shine.

programme.title: Modern Hunter

programme.title: The American Way

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Ralph and Vicki head to Kansas with J and M Whitetails once again for a week of archery hunting in prime whitetail country! Sharing camp and chasing mature bucks together, just like they have for the past 30+ years, everything feels right.

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: Blaine finishes up his blackbuck hunt in Texas then goes after Camp meat. We are officially on doe patrol.

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy
programme.desc: This week on Whitetail Frenzy, we're serving up a triple dose of hunting action! Watch as hunters take on the Governor's One Shot doe challenge, then head south for some intense South Carolina hog hunting.

programme.title: Live The Wild Life

programme.title: Chasin' the Sun

programme.title: All Access Palm Beaches

programme.title: Larysa Unleashed

programme.title: Fishing and Hunting Texas
programme.desc: Host Wade Middleton and friends search for adventures in the outdoors.

programme.title: RV There Yet?

programme.title: Target Rich Environment

programme.title: Higdon Outdoors Tv

programme.title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: Jameson Redding hits the road to find the best fishing spots in America.

programme.title: Trophy Pond

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Green Turtle Cay adventure continues as the LK crew uncovers more of what the incredible out islands of the Bahamas have to offer. Shifting gears to bottom fishing, Ali catches a fish of a lifetime while Rush gets to dive and spearfish with the locals.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Back in San Diego and with Rockfish on the mind, the LK crew fish new grounds and depths to catch these iconic Southern California bottom fish. Along for the ride is pro snowboarder and friend Dave Downing to round out this epic rock cod fishing trip.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: With the drastic changes in the Southern California fishery over the past several years, it has been easy to get fixated on targeting large Bluefin tuna and going all out on what many have coined "big fish" fishing. On this episode Ali and Rush take advantage of the many other opportunities this time of year has to offer and switch focus back to the basics, targeting smaller yellowfin, bluefin, and mahi on bait.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Ram Avtar
programme.desc: Ram and Avtar are both childhood best friends. The difference between the two friends is that Ram would willingly make priceless sacrifice for his friend; the time when both are separated is when Ram goes abroad to further his studies. In the mean while Avtar takes up employment in an organization run by Sangeeta. Avtar is romantically attracted to Sangeeta but Sangeeta falls in love with Ram; when Ram gets to know that Avtar is in love with Sangeeta he decides to sacrifice his love for his friend sake by getting Avtar married to Sangeeta. But one of Sangeeta's enemies Gundappaswami is willing to expose Ram and Sangeeta's relationship to Avtar.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Las mujeres en una ciudad de Louisiana tienen temor de un violador que no deja pistas sobre su identidad.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cuando encuentran muerta a la esposa de un dentista, la policía se esfuerza por identificar a un sospechoso.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra a Joann Katrinak muerta en un campo con su hijo, el sospechoso más obvio es el esposo.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra un cuerpo descompuesto metido en un barril, es fácil suponer un asesinato.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de un policía se incendia, los expertos sospechan de un incendio provocado.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Dianna Green es atacada y su hijo por nacer muere. Ella identifica a su marido como el agresor.

programme.title: Hasta la noche, mi amor
programme.desc: Jason Patric (LOS CHICOS PERDIDOS) protagoniza este fascinante Suspenso donde la tensión erótica explota en violencia al ir mal un secuestro.

programme.title: Sonrisa peligrosa
programme.desc: El divertidísimo Steve Martin protagoniza esta comedia negra sobre un buen hombre que se desvía del buen camino, junto a Helena Bonham Carter, Laura Dern y Scott Caan.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Boo! 2 A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: La hija de Brian (Tyler Perry) se escapa para asistir a una fiesta en una casa encantada de un campamento y son Madea, Bam, Hattie y Joe quienes se embarcarán en un desternillante viaje para llevarla de vuelta casa ahuyentando de su camino a monstruos, duendes y fiesteros animales con miedo y risa a partes iguales.

programme.title: El gran Buck Howard
programme.desc: Un ilusionista está al borde de la quiebra y debe conformarse con actuar en pequeños pueblos, pero su ayudante hará todo lo posible porque vuelva a recuperar el éxito perdido.

programme.title: Memorias de un Zombie Adolescente
programme.desc: R (Nicholas Hoult) es un zombie que vaga perdido, solo y sin rumbo tras una plaga mundial que ha convertido a casi toda la población en muertos vivientes. En una excursión a la ciudad junto con su amigo M (Rob Corddry) para buscar algo fresco que llevarse a la boca, R conoce casualmente a Julie, una joven humana a la que salva de convertirse en el menú del día sin saber muy bien por qué.

programme.title: De Tyler Perry ¡Boo! El Halloween de Madea
programme.desc: En la noche más espeluznante del año, Madea tiene que quedarse a vigilar a la hija adolescente de Brian para que no se meta en líos. Lo que Madea ignora, es el lío que se le avecina a ella. Por suerte, o no, tiene a su pandilla, Bam, Hattie y Joe para protegerla de los fantasmas y payasos asesinos. Es un festival de sustos en la que todas las maldades se desatan.

programme.title: School Rock Band
programme.desc: Tres estudiantes de música entablan una insólita amistad después de formar un grupo de música juntos para competir en un concurso de su instituto.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Mientras lidia con unos rusos furiosos, el Mi5 británico, su bella mujer y un terrorista internacional, Charlie Mortdecai (Johnny Depp), un caballeroso marchante, deberá atravesar el mundo sin más armas que su atractivo y su encanto especial en una carrera para recuperar un cuadro robado que podría contener el código de una cuenta bancaria olvidada repleta de oro nazi.

programme.title: La guarida del gusano blanco
programme.desc: La última novela de Bram Stoker sirve de base para esta fascinante historia sobre una bestia aterradora y las fuerzas malignas que desata en la hermosa campiña inglesa.

programme.title: Nekrotronic
programme.desc: Cuando un demonio posee internet, un técnico de baños portátiles y un cazador de demonios deben unir fuerzas para eliminar el mal de la red antes de que cause daño alguno.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Mientras lidia con unos rusos furiosos, el Mi5 británico, su bella mujer y un terrorista internacional, Charlie Mortdecai (Johnny Depp), un caballeroso marchante, deberá atravesar el mundo sin más armas que su atractivo y su encanto especial en una carrera para recuperar un cuadro robado que podría contener el código de una cuenta bancaria olvidada repleta de oro nazi.

programme.title: El grito
programme.desc: Karen es una enfermera estadounidense que vive en Tokio y que está expuesta a una misteriosa maldición sobrenatural. La maldición es un espíritu vengativo que posee a una persona con una ira poderosa antes de reclamar su vida y propagarse a otra víctima.

programme.title: El Grito 2
programme.desc: En Tokio, la hermana de una chica asesinada por una maldición cae víctima de la misma maldición. Con la ayuda de un periodista, debe encontrar cómo detenerla de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Una bala en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Un detective desconfiado se ve envuelto en las aparentemente turbias vidas de un juez y su esposa cuando descubre que están relacionados con un hombre de inclinaciones delictivas.

programme.title: El juego de los extraños
programme.desc: Una madre trabajadora contrata a un canguro para que cuide de su hijo, pero pronto descubre que es un psicópata antisocial decidido a destruir a su familia.

programme.title: El sexo y la Sra. X
programme.desc: Es curioso lo que una mujer que acaba de quedarse soltera puede aprender sobre el amor y la vida durante unos días en París. Y, para colmo, se lo enseña la directora de una agencia de señoritas de compañía de lujo.

programme.title: El grito
programme.desc: Karen es una enfermera estadounidense que vive en Tokio y que está expuesta a una misteriosa maldición sobrenatural. La maldición es un espíritu vengativo que posee a una persona con una ira poderosa antes de reclamar su vida y propagarse a otra víctima.

programme.title: Desde París con amor
programme.desc: Un agente de inteligencia de bajo rango que trabaja con el embajador de EE.UU. en Francia asume más de lo que esperaba cuando se asocia con un agente estadounidense de alto rango que ha sido enviado a París para detener un ataque terrorista.

programme.title: Wolf Creek
programme.desc: Los mochileros varados en la remota Australia caen presa de un bosquimano asesino que se ofrece a arreglar su coche y luego los lleva cautivos.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Basada en el best-seller de Zane. La triunfadora empresaria Zoe Reynard parece haberlo conseguido todo: un marido de ensueño al que adora, dos hijos maravillosos y una carrera de éxito. Pero, por muy perfecto que parezca desde fuera, a Zoe aún le atraen tentaciones a las que no puede resistir y de las que no puede escapar.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: GUERRERO narra la inspiradora historia de una familia rota que encuentra la redención en el lugar más insospechado: un ring de Artes Marciales Mixtas.

programme.title: El gran debate
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de Melvin B. Tolson, profesor del Wiley College de Texas, una universidad de alumnos negros. En 1935, Tolson inspiró a los estudiantes a formar el primer equipo de debate de la universidad y lo condujo a derrotar a Harvard en los campeonatos nacionales.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: Del visionario director Tim Burton (Eduardo Manostijeras) llega la escandalosa historia real de uno de los fraudes de arte más extensos del siglo XX. Protagonizada por Christoph Waltz y Amy Adams.

programme.title: Mientras estés con migo
programme.desc: De los creadores de LA CANCIÓN DE MI PADRE nos llega la verdadera historia de la vida de la megaestrella de la música cristiana Jeremy Camp. El extraordinario viaje de amor y pérdida de Jeremy demuestra que siempre hay esperanza en medio de la tragedia y que la fe puesta a prueba es la única fe que vale la pena compartir.

programme.title: La guarida del gusano blanco
programme.desc: La última novela de Bram Stoker sirve de base para esta fascinante historia sobre una bestia aterradora y las fuerzas malignas que desata en la hermosa campiña inglesa.

programme.title: Puta
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionada por su marido, una joven cae en la pobreza. Luchando por mantener a su bebé, acepta dinero a cambio de una cita, y así comienza su dura vida en la calle.

programme.title: La guarida del gusano blanco
programme.desc: La última novela de Bram Stoker sirve de base para esta fascinante historia sobre una bestia aterradora y las fuerzas malignas que desata en la hermosa campiña inglesa.

programme.title: El Hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: El presidente asigna a un especialista en contraterrorismo la tarea de localizar a un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un dispositivo nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Cuando un familiar de uno de los suyos es atacado, un equipo de antiguos soldados de élite es llamado de nuevo a la acción.

programme.title: One Million K(l)icks
programme.desc: Un luchador con un corazón de oro se ve arrastrado a un torneo de artes marciales clandestino.

programme.title: Gun Fight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un alguacil en un enfrentamiento con una banda de forajidos sedienta de sangre conocida como Los Hellhounds que han invadido su pequeña ciudad del este de Texas.

programme.title: 90 Minutos
programme.desc: Castle Heights, un hospital abandonado a punto de ser demolido, esconde 3 millones de dólares ocultos por un criminal. Tres partes compiten por el botín: un ex-luchador que trabaja en la demolición, un guardia de prisión sin escrúpulos y una banda violenta. Con 90 minutos antes del derrumbe, comienza una carrera contrarreloj por el dinero y la supervivencia.

programme.title: Desierto de Fuego
programme.desc: Thriller de secuestros dirigido por Werner Herzog. Laura es secuestrada cuando investiga un terrible desastre ecológico por el líder de la corporación responsable de la catástrofe (Michael Shannon), que no puede permitir que sus crímenes salgan a la luz. Al mismo tiempo, bajo sus pies, un gigantesco volcán está a punto de entrar en erupción, lo que hace aún más urgente el rescate.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: Basada en la legendaria Batalla de Myeongnyang. En 1597, durante la invasión japonesa de Corea, el almirante Yi Sun-Shin se enfrenta con solo 12 barcos y una tripulación inexperta a una flota japonesa de más de 300 navíos. Tras la destrucción del Barco Tortuga, última esperanza de Joseon, deberá usar su ingenio y valentía para cambiar el curso de la guerra.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Cuando un familiar de uno de los suyos es atacado, un equipo de antiguos soldados de élite es llamado de nuevo a la acción.

programme.title: One Million K(l)icks
programme.desc: Un luchador con un corazón de oro se ve arrastrado a un torneo de artes marciales clandestino.

programme.title: Gun Fight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un alguacil en un enfrentamiento con una banda de forajidos sedienta de sangre conocida como Los Hellhounds que han invadido su pequeña ciudad del este de Texas.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: Basada en la legendaria Batalla de Myeongnyang. En 1597, durante la invasión japonesa de Corea, el almirante Yi Sun-Shin se enfrenta con solo 12 barcos y una tripulación inexperta a una flota japonesa de más de 300 navíos. Tras la destrucción del Barco Tortuga, última esperanza de Joseon, deberá usar su ingenio y valentía para cambiar el curso de la guerra.

programme.title: Desierto de Fuego
programme.desc: Thriller de secuestros dirigido por Werner Herzog. Laura es secuestrada cuando investiga un terrible desastre ecológico por el líder de la corporación responsable de la catástrofe (Michael Shannon), que no puede permitir que sus crímenes salgan a la luz. Al mismo tiempo, bajo sus pies, un gigantesco volcán está a punto de entrar en erupción, lo que hace aún más urgente el rescate.

programme.title: El Hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: El presidente asigna a un especialista en contraterrorismo la tarea de localizar a un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un dispositivo nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: 90 Minutos
programme.desc: Castle Heights, un hospital abandonado a punto de ser demolido, esconde 3 millones de dólares ocultos por un criminal. Tres partes compiten por el botín: un ex-luchador que trabaja en la demolición, un guardia de prisión sin escrúpulos y una banda violenta. Con 90 minutos antes del derrumbe, comienza una carrera contrarreloj por el dinero y la supervivencia.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que reparte acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan. Cuando un joven se dispone a aprender a luchar del mismísimo Maestro, no sólo es testigo de espectaculares combates, sino que aprende importantes lecciones de vida por el camino.

programme.title: El ejecutor
programme.desc: Kyle fue criado por un corrupto sacerdote que lo entrenó para hacer el mal, bajo el pretexto de ejecutar la justicia divina. Pero ahora comienza a replantearse su vida y a cuestionarse las retorcidas directrices de su maestro. Sin embargo, el sacerdote no estará dispuesto a dejarlo ir y Kyle tendrá que luchar para salvar la vida de su nueva familia ante la amenaza de su propio mentor.

programme.title: Sharknado 5: Aletamiento Global
programme.desc: Con gran parte de América del Norte en ruinas, el resto del mundo se prepara para lo inevitable: un tiburón global. Desde Londres hasta Asia, desde Australia hasta Italia, Fin y su familia deben poner fin a los tiburones de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Cuestión de honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo. Junto con su tío, traman una venganza contra los asesinos que mataron a toda su familia cuando él era joven.

programme.title: Cold Cross
programme.desc: El joven forajido William McCarthy está persiguiendo a todos los hombres que ayudaron a traicionar y asesinar a su madre y a su padre. Impulsado por su sed de venganza, William se dirige a la ciudad de Cold Cross, sin saber que él también está siendo perseguido por el vengativo hermano del sheriff al que mató.

programme.desc: Kevin, Sam y Rob son miembros fundadores de un grupo teórico que lleva a cabo atracos. Leo, un gángster, los chantajea para que perpetren un verdadero atraco multimillonario. Ahora depende de ellos salir con vida.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn’t like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! - Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn’t like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya’s mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can’t be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear’s distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn’t have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it’s Masha’s turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one’s pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it’s all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds’ language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.
